config.url: Base URL of an already running `dsh web` server (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:3080`). Leave empty to let the extension start and manage its own server.
config.autoStart: Start `dsh web` automatically when VS Code starts.
config.openPanelOnStartup: Open the chat panel in the editor area when VS Code starts.
config.command: Command used to launch the server (falls back to `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest`).
config.startTimeoutSec: How long to wait for the server to become ready, in seconds.
config.defaultReasoningEffort: Default thinking depth for new sessions (e.g. `off`, `low`, `high`, `max`). Leave empty to use the server default.
config.showUsageStats: Show token usage and timing details inside collapsible rows.
